# NXT Foundry

> Boutique management consulting and technology practice based in Bengaluru, India, for owner-led and mid-market businesses. Works on operations and business performance, revenue and financial control, procurement and supply chain, and inventory and margin, with expertise in internal controls (SOX 404 / ICoFR, ITGC), internal audit, risk analytics and process automation. Senior-led, with Big 4 risk advisory experience: the people clients meet are the people who do the work.

## Services
- [Advisory & Diagnostics](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#solutions): Short diagnostic engagements that identify operational and control weaknesses, and ongoing senior advisory
- [Managed Solutions & Execution](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#solutions): Hands-on implementation of fixes alongside client teams
- [Technology & Automation](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#products): Workflow automation, BI and business apps, including reconciliation tools
